d: An anthropomorphic bear with a stocky, muscular build and an apparent age of middle maturity. The creature has deep brown fur, a thick beard, and small, dark, focused eyes. It wears a red hooded cowl with ear-like protrusions, a red and white tunic cinched by a brown leather belt with a gold buckle, brown trousers, and dark brown boots. The bear carries a massive axe with a silver blade and a wooden handle. BODY COLOR: Deep brown LEGS: Plantigrade with thick, furred feet and claws.
